name: git-user-profile
description: Copy selected git user profile settings from the host into the container.

copyKeys.description: Keys to copy from exported git config. Use 'default' (user.name, user.email, user.signingkey, commit.gpgsign), 'all', or a comma-separated list.

includeLocal.description: Also parse the exported local config file after the global file to allow overrides.

globalFile.description: Workspace-relative path to the exported global git config file.

localFile.description: Workspace-relative path to the exported local git config file.
